steps.en: Install the Python env and LaTeX, then run the template's baseline yourself
steps.zh: 装好 Python 环境与 LaTeX，并自己跑一遍模板基线
steps.code: pip install -r requirements.txt · python experiment.py --out_dir run_0

steps.en: Launch paper generation for one of the templates on a frontier model
steps.zh: 指定模板与前沿模型，启动论文生成

steps.en: Generates candidate ideas and checks each one for novelty against the literature
steps.zh: 生成候选想法，并逐个到文献里查新

steps.en: Writes the experiment code, runs it on your GPUs, and plots the results
steps.zh: 写出实验代码，在你的 GPU 上跑，再出图

steps.en: Drafts the paper from the template's LaTeX and compiles a PDF
steps.zh: 按模板的 LaTeX 起草论文并编译出 PDF

steps.en: Score the generated paper with the bundled LLM reviewer
steps.zh: 用内置的 LLM 评审给生成的论文打分

steps.en: Keep the paper, or re-run the idea with the reviewer's feedback
steps.zh: 留下论文，或带着评审意见重跑这个想法

value.en: You stop hand-walking idea → code → experiment → write-up: one command turns a template and a frontier model into a compiled paper and a review score
value.zh: idea 到代码、到实验、到成稿这一整圈不再由你手工走：一条命令把模板和前沿模型变成编译好的论文和一份评审分

sources: README.md (installation: conda env + sudo apt-get install texlive-full + pip install -r requirements.txt; per-template baseline runs python experiment.py --out_dir run_0; python launch_scientist.py --model "claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022" --experiment nanoGPT_lite --num-ideas 2; the reviewer snippet perform_review(paper_txt, model, client, num_reflections=5, ...) and review["Decision"]; FAQ cost <$15 per paper, three maintained templates, ideas restricted to what can be expressed in code; the Caution about executing LLM-written code; containerization via experimental/Dockerfile; License & Responsible Use)
ai_scientist/ module layout (generate_ideas.py, perform_experiments.py, perform_writeup.py, perform_review.py, llm.py)
requirements.txt (anthropic, openai, aider-chat, google-generativeai, torch, transformers, datasets, wandb, matplotlib, pypdf)
LICENSE + commit history (Apache-2.0 re-licensed to The AI Scientist Source Code License v1.0 on 2025-12-19; mandatory machine-generation disclosure clause 3.2.e, downstream propagation clause 3.3)
